faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026 is 05 August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the posts of Project Scientist-I and Project Associate-I in Bharathidasan University Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for Project Scientist-I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Scientist-I is Rs. 56,000/- per month plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: The salary for Project Associate-I is Rs. 25,000/- per month plus 18% HRA.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Scientist-I?
faq.answer: For Project Scientist-I, a Ph.D. in Marine Science / Marine Biotechnology / Biotechnology / Microbiology / Life Science with two years of research experience in the relevant field is required.

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for Project Associate-I?
faq.answer: For Project Associate-I, an M.Sc. in Marine Science / Marine Biotechnology / Microbiology / Biotechnology / Life Science / Environmental Science / Chemistry / Botany is required.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be found on the official website of Bharathidasan University, and links are provided in the "Important Links" section.
